description: This file contains Makefile definitions used for building and configuring firmware images and device configurations for a Linux-based embedded system, specifically for OpenWrt/LEDE projects. It defines build procedures, device-specific parameters, and image handling rules.

methods.name: Build/fortigate-header
methods.description: Defines a build procedure to create a custom header for Fortinet FortiGate firmware images, involving zero-padding, data length calculation, and data formatting.

methods.name: Device/dsa-migration
methods.description: Defines device compatibility version and migration message related to switching from swconfig to DSA network configuration.

methods.name: Device/kernel-size-migration
methods.description: Defines device compatibility version and messaging for kernel size changes affecting upgrade procedures.
